title: Amazon.com, Inc. — Annual Report (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE for offline demo/evals)
body:
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — This document is an invented excerpt in the style of a 10-K, bundled for offline demos and evaluation. Its figures are fictional and must not be used as financial data.

ITEM 1. BUSINESS

Amazon.com, Inc. serves consumers, sellers, developers, enterprises and content creators. Net sales for 2025 were $637.9 billion, an increase of 11 percent. Amazon Web Services (AWS) net sales were $107.6 billion, growing 19 percent year over year, and AWS operating income was $39.8 billion, representing the majority of the Company's consolidated operating income. Advertising services revenue was $56.2 billion, up 20 percent. The Company continues to invest in its stores, logistics network, AWS infrastructure, and initiatives including Project Kuiper, its low-earth-orbit satellite broadband network.

ITEM 1A. RISK FACTORS

The Company is subject to intense competition in each of its businesses. Government regulation presents material uncertainty: the United States Federal Trade Commission and certain state attorneys general have filed suit alleging anticompetitive conduct in the operation of the Company's online marketplace, and adverse outcomes could require changes to business practices. Expansion of the fulfilment and transportation network requires substantial capital expenditure, and excess capacity or misplaced facilities could impair results. Investment in Project Kuiper involves significant expenditure ahead of any material revenue, and the satellite broadband market may develop more slowly than expected.

ITEM 7. MANAGEMENT'S DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS OF FINANCIAL CONDITION AND RESULTS OF OPERATIONS

Operating income for 2025 was $71.2 billion, up from $60.5 billion in 2024, driven by AWS growth and improved North America segment margins from regionalisation of the fulfilment network. Capital expenditures including finance leases were $83.0 billion, principally for AWS infrastructure including datacenters and custom Trainium silicon, and for the transportation network. Free cash flow was $48.3 billion for the trailing twelve months.
